admission_rules: Refresh live main, open PRs, branches, claims, and dependency state before mutation.
If an implementation already owns the requested scope, verify or hand off instead of duplicating it.
PREP is not IMPLEMENTED; IMPLEMENTED is not VERIFIED; VERIFIED is not INTEGRATED.
Do not enable provider billing or secrets as an autonomous queue action.

tasks.purpose: Inventory existing dispatcher, claims, ledger, quarantine, handoff, queue, and recovery assets before any new autonomous implementation.
acceptance: Existing overlapping implementations are classified CURRENT, STALE, SUPERSEDED, CONFLICTING, or UNKNOWN.
One canonical owner is selected per mutable scope.
No duplicate dispatcher, ledger, queue, or quarantine engine is created.
tasks.exact_next_action: Refresh live GitHub and inspect existing tools/automation, automation-related PRs/branches, claims, and tests; produce a reconciliation map and claim only an unowned gap.

tasks.purpose: Complete or consolidate durable claims, queue, checkpoints, dependency admission, quarantine, and recovery around one canonical automation control plane.
acceptance: Atomic claim/release semantics.
Dependency-aware admission.
Crash-safe checkpoint/recovery.
Quarantine releases occupied concurrency slots.
Tests prove no duplicate ownership and no starvation.
tasks.exact_next_action: After AE-002, implement only the missing canonical gaps using strict TDD and reuse any verified existing automation assets.

tasks.purpose: Verify the integrated collaboration bridge contract without enabling paid provider calls or changing protected server settings.
acceptance: Workflow and policy file remain mutually consistent.
Untrusted PR-head code is never executed with provider secrets.
Cost guard remains fail-closed.
Required future server-side check name is documented as ai-architecture-review.
tasks.exact_next_action: Perform a static exact-head review of the integrated workflow and document any server-side configuration still requiring an explicit human gate.

tasks.purpose: Activate provider-backed collaboration only after explicit owner authorization, current billing evidence, secrets readiness, and server-side required-check configuration.
acceptance: Owner explicitly authorizes billing state.
Secrets are stored only in GitHub Actions Secrets.
Activation variables are configured deliberately.
ai-architecture-review is made required only through an authorized server-side policy change.
tasks.exact_next_action: Wait for explicit human authorization and verified zero-additional-billing evidence; do not autonomously change secrets, billing approval, or branch protection.

tasks.purpose: Admit the next product/language wave through the durable control plane instead of ad-hoc parallel execution.
acceptance: Dependencies and ownership are explicit.
Language directionality is explicit.
Candidate data is not promoted to canonical without validation.
Canonical quality gates remain unchanged.
tasks.exact_next_action: Select the highest-priority owner-approved product task, assign its mutable scope, and create its continuation capsule before implementation.
